# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010), [v4 c5 P0](../source/v04-c05.md#nw-v04-c05-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Dr. Blythe  <sub>[v4 c2 P10](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0010), [v4 c6 P8](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome man with curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. As he matures, he becomes tall, broad-shouldered, and frank-faced, with a strong, clean-shaven chin. His appearance is noted for being manly and handsome, with a clear-cut look as he grows into adulthood.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c31 P16](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0016), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v3 c35 P1](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Gilbert is determined, ambitious, and highly clever, possessing a strong sense of humor and a teasing, playful disposition. He is deeply devoted, faithful, and persistent in his affections, yet capable of great chivalry and self-sacrifice. As a doctor, he is dedicated, brave, and driven by a strong desire to fight disease, pain, and ignorance to serve his fellow human beings.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014), [v3 c20 P25](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0025), [v4 c8 P9](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0009)_

## History

Gilbert Blythe grows up in Avonlea and attends the local school, where he quickly becomes Anne Shirley's rival after teasing her about her red hair on his first day back from Alberta. Although Anne refuses to speak to him for years, Gilbert quietly holds a deep affection for her while excelling academically alongside her. After graduating from Queen's Academy, he generously surrenders his application for the Avonlea school so that Anne can teach there and remain near Marilla, taking the White Sands school instead. Later, he attends Redmond College, where he studies diligently, excels in athletics, and wins the prestigious Cooper Prize. After Anne refuses his initial marriage proposal in their Sophomore year, he maintains a respectful distance while continuing his studies and eventually completing his medical degree. After recovering from a severe bout of typhoid fever, he learns that Anne does not love Roy Gardner and renews his suit in Hester Gray's garden, where she accepts him. Following his graduation, he takes over his great-uncle's medical practice in Four Winds Harbor, marries Anne in the orchard at Green Gables, and settles with her in their 'house of dreams.' There they experience the tragic loss of their firstborn infant daughter, Joyce, before welcoming their healthy son, James Matthew ('Jem'). Later, Gilbert purchases the larger Morgan estate at Glen St. Mary to accommodate his growing family and expanding medical practice.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 c20 P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c40 P14](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0014), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 c41 P31](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0031), [v4 c2 P16](../source/v04-c02.md#nw-v04-c02-p0016), [v4 c4 P15](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0015), [v4 c19 P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 c19 P17](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0017), [v4 c34 P2](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0002), [v4 c34 P21](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0021), [v4 c40 P17](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0017)_

## Background by volume

- Lived in Alberta for three years during his youth due to his father's health  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School, Queen's Academy, and Redmond College  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c17 P37](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0037), [v3 c5 P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000)</sub>
- Taught school at White Sands to pay for his college education  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- Took High Honors in Classics and won the Cooper Prize at Redmond  <sub>[v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023)</sub>

## Quotes

> I want to fight disease and pain and ignorance... I want to do my share of honest, real work in the world, Anne...  <sub>[v2 c7 P14](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0014)</sub>

> Anne, I love you. You know I do. I—I can't tell you how much. Will you promise me that some day you'll be my wife?  <sub>[v3 c20 P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031)</sub>

> I asked you a question over two years ago, Anne. If I ask it again today will you give me a different answer?  <sub>[v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024)</sub>

> When a fellow has a home and a dear, little, red-haired wife in it what more need he ask of life?  <sub>[v4 c14 P18](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0018)</sub>

> Ye shall know the truth and the truth shall make you free.  <sub>[v4 c29 P60](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0060)</sub>
